messages:
dan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners and timelines for the cross-region routing + TLS retry spikes last night.

sara: Thanks. I can take the routing/traffic-shaping items. I'll own the traceroute/log‑correlation work to prove scope. @jyoti can you take LB config/QoS? :eyes:

jyoti: I can. Initial plan: 1) dump LB route table snapshots across regions, 2) validate healthcheck time alignment, 3) add additional metrics for SNI mismatch counts. Will have snapshots by EOD tomorrow.

mike: I'll take TLS side — cert rotation checks and handshake retry tracing. I want to confirm whether retries came from upstream client or our egress.

oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2026 status updated: follow-up thread opened by dan. Severity: P2 -> monitoring.

dan: Ownership looks good. Let's be explicit on deliverables:
- sara: correlate client IP / region with routing ejects and provide CSV + short writeup (due +48h).
- jyoti: LB config diffs + healthcheck alignment plan (due +72h).
- mike: TLS handshake pcap sampling and cert rotation audit (due +72h).

sara: noted. I'll push a gist with correlation SQL and sample queries. Example query I'll run:
```sql
SELECT region, count(*) as ejects, avg(latency)
FROM lb_events
WHERE event = 'backend_eject' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20' AND '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY region;
```

jyoti: For healthchecks, suspect mismatch between short probe TTL and new deploys causing delayed re-add. I'll add an invariant test in canary: ensure healthcheck threshold >= deploy warmup latency. Draft PR by tomorrow.

mike: For TLS: observed elevated ClientHello retransmits in the pcap. Plan: enable 1s sampling on edge ELBs for next 6h, aggregate handshakes by cipher/sni/client_ip. Will also verify our cert chain validity across regions.

infra-eng: FYI, there's an existing retry-loop mitigation RFC from last quarter that we should reuse instead of inventing a patch. See link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/retry-loop-mitigation

sara: Good call, will check RFC. If we can reuse, reduces owner work.

dan: Also want a note on recurrence: ops noticed similar but less severe spikes ~monthly. Add a recurring-incident tracking tag and set a zoom sync next week to decide long-term fix.

jyoti: Adding tag: recurrence:monthly. Also will add a dashboard panel for SNI mismatch rate and regional ejects ratio.

mike: Heads-up: if certificate expiration is ruled out, we should instrument TLS handshake state machine metrics in runtime — that'll take ~2w. I'll scope after the 72h audit.

sara: Can we get quick wins? I'll add an alert to paging when eject rate exceeds 2% across a region for 5m. That should catch early flaps.

dan: Agreed. Action items recap in root thread by EOD: owners + due dates. I'll create a tracking board and link it here.

oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-ups due dates approaching. Use /followup update to link completed items.

mike: Quick note — if anybody replicates the pattern, include a full flow trace with upstream IPs; don't redact internal ASNs for debugging.

sara: Putting first draft of correlation CSV and alert rule in the incident board: https://redwood.internal/board/INC-2026-followups

jyoti: PR for healthcheck alignment opened: https://git.redwood/infra/merge/4721 — requesting review from infra-eng.

dan: Thanks team. We'll do a brief sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to validate initial artifacts. If anything blocks owners, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
